Sensitivity analysis

Perturbations are finite changes, not linear derivatives. Interactions and uncertain response curves can change the ranking.

READ THE MODEL

Mechanism before magnitude.

Fuel changes mass. Wind changes local relative airflow. Grip changes the cornering, braking and traction envelope.

The assumed tyre response and wing trade-off are useful experiments, with limited predictive evidence.
